==Biography==
Since the inception of the Sentinels, d4rkness has shown his ability to play multiple roles on a professional level. He first started out playing as AP mid for the Sentinels, then at [[IPL Face Off: San Francisco Showdown]] played as AD bot lane along with [[EquivocaL]] as his support, after several role swaps within the Sentinels d4rkness played as a support for [[ly4ly4ly4]] and later became the jungler for [[Singapore Sentinels]]. On September 20, 2013 SGS announced he's been released from the roster to pursue his studies full-time.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=385826361543921&set=a.142606159199277.27089.132986296827930&type=1 Singapore Sentinels release ToFu and d4rkness] ''facebook.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Has played every role professionally.
* Favorite food is crème brûlée.
* Has played over 1,000 matches with {{ci|Nocturne}} in solo queue.
